Amalfi Coast guide 🍋🇮🇹
📌 Save this for your next trip

☀️ What to do:
• Positano for chic beach clubs, pastel houses, and shopping
• Amalfi for cathedral views, seaside strolls, and all the lemon treats
• Atrani for a peaceful village moment away from the crowds
• Ravello for iconic gardens and panoramic terraces at Villa Cimbrone and Villa Rufolo
• Take a boat day, because the Amalfi Coast looks even better from the water
• Hike the Path of the Gods for unreal panoramic views
• Stop at Fiordo di Furore, one of the most iconic spots on the coast

reels.caption:
Save this Riad in Marrakech 🇲🇦

If you're visiting Marrakech, this is a great place to stay. From the moment we arrived, the staff were incredibly helpful and took the time to explain the city, what to visit, and things to be aware of, which made settling in so much easier.

We stayed in a top floor room that was spacious, bright, and very comfortable. The Riad itself is beautifully designed with multiple chill areas, a small pool, a rooftop, and a terrace, so there's always somewhere to relax after exploring the city.

📍 Location is great. It's only a few minutes walk to the start of the souks, but also close enough to a main road for easy taxi drop-off, which is really useful in Marrakech.

Breakfast is served on the rooftop terrace and includes eggs, fresh fruit, yoghurt, breads, and mint tea.

It's also surprisingly quiet and peaceful, which you really appreciate after a busy day in the medina.

Definitely recommend saving this for your trip!
